title: Day 1 of AI/Algo Trading (Paper) - Posting for accountability
author: Enzobevmax
selftext:
**Day 2 in the books!**

\*\*\*Glitch with GitHub today causing 1 hour delay in getting in the markets. Very rare with this system but we added better watchdog signals to make sure this doesn't happen again.

**Changes before today:**

\- **Promoted** Stretched Below VWAP Bounce and RSI Collapse Dip Buy (all day) to **Primary**(My overzealous decision which was not good today)

\- **Demoted** Early Sellers Above VWAP moved to **Testing** (Claude reco)

\- **Demoted** Gap-Down VWAP Loss Short to **Graveyard** (Claude reco)

Quick answers to common questions:

    - Claude (Opus 5.5) - Python
    - Alpaca API, paper trading, SIP market data (all US exchanges).
    - US stocks + ETFs, intraday only (9:50 AM-3:55 PM ET), long and short, nothing held overnight.
    - Setups built by basic indicators: RSI, VWAP, volume / buy-sell pressure, gaps, opening range, prior-day highs/lows, ATR.
    - Setup Generator - A bot that invents 10 new setups a night and trades them on its own paper account. New concept, setups built randomly on random indicators.
    - Setup Life Cycle - Idea or generator -> 2-yr backtest (costs in) -> test through replay sessions(20+ of them) -> testing (paper) -> Primary (paper) -> real money after the milestones. Losers move down to the Graveyard, never deleted.
    - Avg R - Average result per trade in units of the risk taken, 
    after costs, fees and slippage(
    factored in already).
    - Break-even win rate - Win rate a setup needs just to not lose money.
    - Avg R w/o best day? Same, with its single best session removed - spots records carried by one big day.
    - Accounts meant to start at 100k, could not reset accounts during other testing before starting this without conflicts so some accounts started in a deficit.

**Things I am still wanting**:

\- Better system for more live setups. Reps and exposure to the market make the data wheels churn faster. Love the ideas if you have them!

\- Quality setup ideas - Always looking to add! Especially LONGs as you can see!

**Quick thoughts**:

\- Slowly realizing that removing bad setups from **Primary** is probably 2x better than adding potentially good setups. Maybe we should all not be so eager to think our system/setup works?

\- Patience

\- What I'm not posting is all of the operational decisions and testing that has to be worked through on the backend to mitigate things like duplicate orders from setups if signals re-trigger, setup limits per ticker, stop setup after certain R, etc. It's boring stuff but makes a big difference and takes a lot of time, tokens(usage), and sessions ofr reps. 

As always, thanks so much for the support and input!

Fun stuff!

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Good point about removing bad setups being worth more than adding new ones. That fits what the tables show: the top two setups today are both shorts, and your own note says they depend on the market's direction, so they could look very different on an up day. For the long setups you're looking for, one idea is to test them only on days when the index was up or flat, defined before you test. Then a long that holds there is a real candidate. Full disclosure, I work at Cymetica, and Backtest Labs is one place to test a setup against history with fees and out-of-sample data before it joins a live account.
